8- Required equipment: ABI Step One Plus real-time PCR system (Applied BioSystems)
Table 1. Preparation of the reaction mix.

steps.title: Prepare DNA samples and reagents
steps.instruction: Gently mix the DNA samples and thoroughly mix the reagents using a vortex.

steps.title: Label microtubes
steps.instruction: Label the microtubes and set them aside for the preparation of the mix.

steps.title: Prepare the reaction mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction mix for the required number of reactions using the specified components and concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Assemble all required components except the sample, including 10 μl of 2× TaqMan Gene Expression Master Mix to achieve a final concentration of 1×.
Dispense equal aliquots of the mix into each reaction well.
Add the DNA sample to each reaction tube as the final step.

steps.title: Mix and centrifuge plates
steps.instruction: Thoroughly mix the plates on a vortex and centrifuge them briefly.

steps.title: Perform thermal cycling
steps.instruction: Run the qPCR using the thermal cycling conditions specified in Table 2.

steps.title: Analyze fluorescent data
steps.instruction: Analyze the fluorescent accumulation data using ABI StepOne Software Version 2.2.2 (Applied Biosystems).
